title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode14 Liar

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've gotta pay attention to the angle of my arms here and... Ah!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori! You're not in step with Shizuku!
You've got to pay attention when you're dancing together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi, maybe we should take a break.
I think Minori is having a little trouble focusing today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I... I'm sorry!
And after you were nice enough to practice with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's all right. I understand. You're worried about what Haruka said yesterday, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no reason to hide it. We're worried about her too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After hearing her say she doesn't have the right to be an idol like that, anyone would worry.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There were a lot of articles online and in the magazines claiming they'd uncovered the reason she quit, but none of them rang true.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I figured maybe she really did just want to study at school like a regular student, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I wonder what happened...)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me. Did you submit the application for your audition?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
I made sure to double check the address and the fee, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All that's left now is to cross your fingers, then. You've done everything else you can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Thanks for all the help, Momoi! Hinomori! I'm sure this time will be different!
Momoi? Hinomori?
Wait, are you Momoi from QT and Hinomori from Cheerful*Days?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Who are you?
Not another reporter after an interview with Shizuku, I ho—hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! It's ASRUN's former member, Mai!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh-What are you doing here?! O-Oh! I absolutely loved the song Rainbow Parameters that you and Haruka sang together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You and Haruka were always so perfectly in sync!
Oh, and...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: U-Um... Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Ahhh! I made her uncomfortable!
I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I haven't seen you since you quit ASRUN about a year ago. What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Well, I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did you come to see Haruka?
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I see. So Haruka already went home.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Thank you for helping me look for her, Momoi, Hinomori.
You too, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't mention it.
Why did you decide to wait outside the school gates, though?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know you both quit, but you were in the same group, right? Don't you have her number?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Well... Yes, I do, but...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I wasn't sure I'd be able to say what I wanted to say over the phone or a text.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What you wanted to say?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I get the feeling there's more to this.
We're willing to listen if you need someone to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're all ex-idols, after all. We might be able to help you.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I came to apologize to Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: It's my fault that Haruka quit being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold on, what do you mean it's your fault?
What happened between you two?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I really looked up to Haruka. She's the reason I joined ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Whether it was a concert or an event, Haruka always said she wanted to give everyone hope for tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I really loved that message. Whenever things got tough, I would remember those words and they'd cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I realized that I wanted to become an idol just like Haruka. I practiced my singing and dancing every day. I was so happy when I was accepted into ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I-It's nice to meet you! I'm Mai, the new member! U-Um, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Your words have given me so much hope!
I'm so happy to be a part of ASRUN!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My words did?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you. That makes me happy.
I hope we can both work hard together, Mai.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Even watching from beside her on stage, I still looked up to her. She was always so cool with her straightforward, earnest attitude.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: No matter how hard practice was or how busy my schedule got, I was able to get through it because of her kindness.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Before I realized it, my own popularity started to increase. Eventually, I got to sing up on stage with her.
I was so happy.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But I entered a slump during my third year at ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A slump?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: It happened after I kept messing up the recording of one of our new songs. No matter how much I tried, I just couldn't get my part down.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I even started messing up during our shows. Then my dancing just started falling apart, too. I started becoming a burden on the others.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: It's no good. I just can't sing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's not true. You've improved so much since you started.
If you keep at it—

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: But our next concert is coming up! People are going to see me mess up and start saying I don't practice enough again!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka, I'm afraid! I don't want to go out on stage!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai, tomorrow will always be a better day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hold on to hope and keep working hard, and I'm sure things will get better.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Those words gave me the courage I needed yet again.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I started trying even harder, putting in hours and hours of practice. Even after my trainers told me I wouldn't get any better, I just kept going.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Then, I ended up injuring my vocal cords.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No way...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: After practicing so much I could no longer hit the high notes.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: The doctors said it differed case by case, but that it could take years to fully heal, and if I wasn't careful, the process could take even longer.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: At the time, I basically took that to mean I could no longer be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: The future seemed so dark...so I lashed out at Haruka who'd come to the doctor with me.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Why?! Why can't I sing anymore?! It's not fair!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I worked so hard.
I never gave up, and now this happens?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka... You're a liar!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
You said hope was all I needed!
This all happened because I kept working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
All that time I wasted...
My dream of being an idol! Give it back!
